params.body:
A version with an ampersand came out of the VWE chassis lookup as `Cool & Connect`.

VWE returns an XML string whose content is the real answer, escaped once more. `executeSOAPCall` turned `<`/`>` back into tags but left `&` alone. An `&` in the answer (`&amp;` on the wire) therefore reached `SubModelName`, and from there `package`, as the literal text `&`.

## Change

- `OwnStockService::unwrapVweAnswer()` is the old inline unwrapping, now with one more step. It undoes one level of escaping: `<` and `>` first, `&` last. Text that the inner document escaped itself keeps its own escaping.
- `convertVweJsonToVehicle` decodes entities in `SubModelName`. VWE answers are cached per chassis number, and an answer cached before this change still carries `&`.
- Vehicles already saved with `&` in `package` are not touched. That would be a one-off cleanup if wanted.

## Tests

- `tests/Unit/VweAnswerKeepsTheAmpersandTest` checks three cases:
  - an ampersand arrives as one;
  - an angle bracket that the inner document escaped stays text;
  - plain text is unchanged.
- I reproduced the old unwrapping on the same input. It yields `Cool & Connect`.
- The full suite and PHPStan pass locally.

Closes #1029
params.title: VWE lookup: an ampersand in the version arrives as one
